name: @nexus/desktop
description: Nexus desktop shell — Tauri 2 (cf. ADR-026). Les sources Rust vivent dans `src-tauri/`. Le frontend reste `@nexus/web` consommé via tauri.conf.json (devUrl + frontendDist).

scripts.build: echo "(build géré par tauri build, scripts tauri:*)"
scripts.dev: echo "(dev géré par tauri dev, scripts tauri:*)"
scripts.lint: echo "(pas de lint TS — Rust via just rust-check, cf. job CI rust)"
scripts.test: echo "(pas de tests V1 TS — Rust via just rust-check, cf. job CI rust)"
scripts.rust:check: cargo fmt --check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
